answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor emitting a periodic signed liveness signal no wallet can mint in bulk; standing climbs only as several already-established peers from separate funding clusters co-sign audited work, each a lantern lit by its own distinct source. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet traces every signal back to a single river, so its lanterns never span distinct clusters and its standing stalls; one hundred heads cost one hundred anchors plus one hundred slow climbs, honest pays once.
